title: Reduced order modeling for spatio-temporal pattern approximation in diffusive Lotka-Volterra equations
summary: This paper presents an efficient reduced order modeling (ROM) framework for simulating spatio-temporal pattern formation in three-species diffusive Lotka-Volterra systems. To alleviate the high computational cost associated with long-time simulations of the high-dimensional full order model (FOM), we apply proper orthogonal decomposition (POD) to project the solution onto a low-dimensional subspace.
